card.summary: Free. 'We do not charge a fee for sharing your data through TCIA except in rare circumstances where proposals are extremely large.'

free_tier.stated: Free. 'We do not charge a fee for sharing your data through TCIA except in rare circumstances where proposals are extremely large.'

retention.stated: Per-object-cap: one zip per DICOM series (tens of MB each). The archive is sharded by series, not by dataset. Retention: permanent, DOI per collection.

egress.terms: Free and anonymous. NBIA REST API serves DICOM series zips with no key; CORS open.

record.tooling: NBIA Data Retriever + documented REST API (`services.cancerimagingarchive.net/nbia-api/services/v1/`), plus the `tcia-utils` Python package. Deposit side has no API. It is a quarterly-reviewed proposal form.
record.chaining: Read side is effectively unlimited and needs no account, so the fetch workload scales independently of any deposit relationship. Deposits: one collection per approval, unlimited collections per institution in principle.

limits.value: review, signed non-negotiable Data Submission Agreement, 'a few months' to complete

record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: one zip per DICOM series (tens of MB each). The archive is sharded by series, not by dataset. Retention: permanent, DOI per collection. Deposit is NOT self-serve: quarterly Advisory Group review, signed non-negotiable Data Submission Agreement, 'a few months' to complete.
record.reliability_note: Deposit is a months-long institutional process; read path is fast and stable. Not a drop-box by any reading.

evidence.proved: 'We do not charge a fee', quarterly review, 'a few months', signed agreement required
